verdict.rationale: TrueLayer is a payments and open-banking platform that handles sensitive financial data, so whether customer data is excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy-posture question. The evidence pack covers payments, webhooks, signing, MFA and an MCP integration, but contains no documentation of an AI-training opt-out or a no-training data policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
